summary: WAYLOAM v0.4.3.alpha makes expedition stops actually visible, turns Ride into a full-screen navigation surface, and replaces arbitrary distance stage cuts with verified overnight-stop planning.
highlights: Water, camps, shelters, food and bicycle-service markers are no longer suppressed by basemap label collisions.
Saved routes with no loaded expedition stops automatically refresh stop discovery when reopened.
Ride removes the app bottom navigation and uses a single top back control over the full-screen map.
Automatic stages target the requested daily distance but end only at verified camps, shelters or huts.
added: Automatic route-stop refresh for restored routes whose persisted POI list is empty.
Verified overnight-aware stage selection around the rider's daily distance target.
A compact top back control for full-screen Ride.
changed: MapLibre expedition markers ignore basemap label placement and use larger always-visible route-critical symbols.
An 80 km stage target can extend to a nearby verified camp, for example 90 km, instead of ending at an arbitrary point.
Ride no longer shows the app-wide bottom navigation bar.
Towns are no longer assumed to be valid overnight stops without proven sleeping infrastructure.
fixed: Existing saved routes no longer remain permanently empty of camps, water and shops after an earlier POI load missed or had not completed.
Automatic stage generation no longer creates overnight stops in the middle of a road.
Route-critical water, camp, food and repair markers no longer disappear due to MapLibre symbol collision rules.
